notes.title: Demo Update - V 0.7.0
notes.notes:
This update includes many changes to the Isometria demo including the following updates wrapped into one. Some items mentioned below are not in the demo but will be available in the full game.

Please keep in mind that save games made prior to this update will no longer work. If you would like to play your old save, download an older version via itch.io.

Have fun and enjoy the game. Please feel free to reach out with comments or feedback. Don't forget to report bugs!

        Updated to pygame-ce 2.5.2
        Reduced garbage collection frequency to reduce frame stuttering

    Saves:
        Improved save and load system
        Old saves will no longer work properly and are no longer visible in menus
        Old demo versions can still be downloaded via Itch.io

    Items:
        Added Prickleheart stew
        Added Respec Potion
        Added Prickle Potion
        Added Fiber Glove
        Throwing damage is now affected by a player's strength

    Entities:
        Fixed lily pad size issues causing lily pads to jitter

    Player:
        Players move a bit slower when moving away from direction of the mouse

    Units:
        Fixed a bug where shops would not restock their inventories correctly

     This is a minor hotfix to address an issue where new characters were not being created with the 
     correct item loadout.

notes.title: Demo Update - Version 0.4.10
notes.notes:
This update features improvements to networking, minor adjustments to some items, and some quality of life additions.

V 0.4.10

    UI:
        Walls, Windows, Fences, Blocks, Tiles, and Posts can now be place in lines by dragging the mouse 
        during placement.
        Added Rx port input and verification to the add host screen.

    Objects:
        Reduced the resource cost of walls.
        Doubled non-ore block resource drop rate.
        Ore blocks now have varied drop rates.

    Networking:
        The local network server will not start until hosting a game.
        Local Rx and Tx ports can now be set before hosting a game.
        Network save settings now contain both the Rx and Tx port settings.
        Fixed a bug where unresolvable hostnames would crash the game.
        An "Unable To Connect" message will now appear if the initial network connection fails.
        Using an invalid port combination in the settings file will now result in the default ports being used.
        Default values will be used if the settings file is missing a setting.

    Other:
        Upgraded to pygame-ce-2.4.0.
        Fixed a bug where the framerate would dip if multiple tiles were placed at the same time.

notes.title: Demo Update - Version 0.4.9
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to include the following changes.

V 0.4.9

    UI:
        Pressing the pause button (default esc) when the recipe book is open now closes the recipe book.

    Objects:
        Trees will no longer leave a stump behind if they are destroyed with large amounts of damage.

    Units:
        Spoderbro no longer drop level 2 orbs which are not fully implemented in the demo.
        Blobby now retreats faster from the player.

    Player:
        Players now regen health at a very slow rate.

    Other:
        Fixed a bug where shift clicking an empty container slot would crash the game.
        Fixed a bug where shift clicking an item in a container would not remove the item from the container 
        correctly.

notes.title: Updated Demo - Version 0.4.8
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to include the following changes and bug fixes. The inclusion of the recipe book (default keybind 'i') should help players to find recipes based on materials they have found.

Expect further improvements in the future such as click and drag placement for tiles and walls, a friendly NPC who will give the player basic instructions, and other quality of life improvements.

V 0.4.8

    UI:
        Improved ingredient and recipe icon frame
        Improved font system
        Added Recipe Book
        Added a message to inform players if someone spawned a boss
        Added some messages to inform the player of their actions
        Added messages to inform the player if their spawnpoint was set or reset

    Items:
        Increased the power usage of the second tier wands
        Trees now drop plant fiber when chopped down
        Added mushroom stew
        Reduced regen bonus and buff length of cooked meat
        Items scooped up by the shovel no longer stack with other items in the world as they are scooped
        Items produced by interacting with an object (mushrooms and flowers) will no longer stack with 
        other item stacks already in the world

    Units:
        Added Goober
        Ghouls will no longer spawn at night unless the player is level 2
        Critters and Units will no longer spawn if a boss is currently spawned on that level

    Networking:
        Added a version check to the server client handshake - older versions will no longer work with this 
        version of the game.

    Other:
        Night time now starts later and is 2 in game hours shorter
        Added missing special characters to the small font
        Fixed a bug where certain server properties were not being reset between sessions
        Fixed a bug where entering the gameover screen while paused would result in a stuck game state
        Fixed a bug where respawning while on the pause menu would not close the gameover screen
        Fixed a bug where too many sounds playing at once could crash the game

notes.title: Demo stamina changes and bug fixes
notes.notes:
After receiving some feedback regarding stamina I've implemented some changes and rebalancing to help.

Changelog:


Increased base stamina and power from 50 to 75.
Increased base stamina and power regen by 25%.
Lowered the stamina cost of most wooden weapons and tools (excluding the dagger).
Decreased the range a player has to be from a crafting station to 2 tile lengths.
Lowered the cost of wooden and stone posts.
Increased wood drop rate from trees.
Spoderbro will not spawn at night until the player is level 3.
Fixed a bug where the roaster would sometimes have the wrong size hitbox after loading a game where the roaster was placed on the border of two or more chunks.
Fixed a bug where item drops would all have the same movement direction.
Trees no longer take damage from ranged weapons.
Fixed a bug where the well fed buff was showing as +0 regen in it's tooltip.


Thanks all for reporting bugs and giving feedback about the game. I will continue to respond to your feedback and implement changes required.

notes.title: Small update - New sound options and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Demo release has been wonderful so far. Today I pushed a small update to fix an audio bug and add support for mono channel audio. Hope you enjoy the changes,

Changelog:


Fixed a bug where audio devices with more than 6 channels would crash the game when playing a sound.
Added the option to disable positional audio in the sound options menu.
Added the option to select either 'mono' or 'stereo' audio mode.
Improved the robustness of the music and sound management code.
Reduced the collision box size of loose items in the game world.


Please report any other bugs on via the Community page.

Thank you for playing Isometria!
